Worst cases by Dice similarity coefficient

Violet: true positive · orange: missed (false negative) · teal: added (false positive). Radiological orientation.

Metric glossary

Dice similarity coefficient DSC

Twice the overlap divided by the total size of both masks; the most common segmentation score.

$$\mathrm{DSC} = \frac{2|P\cap G|}{|P|+|G|} = \frac{2TP}{2TP+FP+FN}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · dice
Dice 1945, Ecology 26(3); Sørensen 1948

Intersection over union (Jaccard index) IoU

Overlap divided by the union of both masks; a stricter monotone transform of Dice.

$$\mathrm{IoU} = \frac{|P\cap G|}{|P\cup G|} = \frac{TP}{TP+FP+FN} = \frac{\mathrm{DSC}}{2-\mathrm{DSC}}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · iou
Jaccard 1912, New Phytologist 11(2)

Normalized surface Dice NSD

Fraction of both surfaces lying within a clinically acceptable tolerance tau of the other surface.

$$\mathrm{NSD}_\tau = \frac{|\{d\in D_{P\to G}: d\le\tau\}| + |\{d\in D_{G\to P}: d\le\tau\}|}{|\partial P| + |\partial G|}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · nsd
Nikolov et al. 2021, J Med Internet Res 23(7):e26151

95th-percentile Hausdorff distance HD95

Near-worst boundary error, ignoring the 5 % most extreme surface points (BraTS, KiTS, TopCoW...).

$$\mathrm{HD}_{95} = \max\Big(P_{95}(D_{P\to G}),\; P_{95}(D_{G\to P})\Big)$$

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit mm · hd95
Huttenlocher et al. 1993; Bakas et al. 2018, arXiv:1811.02629 (BraTS)

Average symmetric surface distance ASSD

Mean distance over all surface points of both masks: the typical boundary error in mm.

$$\mathrm{ASSD} = \frac{\sum D_{P\to G} + \sum D_{G\to P}}{|\partial P| + |\partial G|}$$

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit mm · assd
Heimann et al. 2009, IEEE TMI 28(8); Yeghiazaryan & Voiculescu 2018, J Med Imaging 5(1)

Mean average surface distance MASD

Average of the two directed mean distances; unlike ASSD, both surfaces weigh equally regardless of size.

$$\mathrm{MASD} = \tfrac{1}{2}\big(\overline{D_{P\to G}} + \overline{D_{G\to P}}\big)$$

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit mm · masd
Yeghiazaryan & Voiculescu 2018, J Med Imaging 5(1); Maier-Hein et al. 2024 (Metrics Reloaded)

Precision (positive predictive value) PPV

Fraction of predicted voxels that are truly foreground; penalises over-segmentation.

$$\mathrm{PPV} = \frac{TP}{TP+FP}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · precision
Taha & Hanbury 2015, BMC Med Imaging 15:29

Recall (sensitivity, true-positive rate) TPR

Fraction of the reference that was found; penalises under-segmentation.

$$\mathrm{TPR} = \frac{TP}{TP+FN}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · recall
Taha & Hanbury 2015, BMC Med Imaging 15:29

Relative volume difference RVD

Signed volume error relative to the reference volume; −0.2 means 20 % under-segmented.

$$\mathrm{RVD} = \frac{|P| - |G|}{|G|}$$

Range [-1.000, ∞] · 0 is ideal · unit – · relative_volume_difference
Heimann et al. 2009, IEEE TMI 28(8)

Absolute volume difference AVD

Magnitude of the volume error in mL (used e.g. by ISLES and autoPET).

$$\mathrm{AVD} = |V_P - V_G|$$

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit mL · absolute_volume_difference
Hernandez Petzsche et al. 2022, Sci Data 9:762 (ISLES'22)

Lesion-wise recall (detection sensitivity) L-TPR

Fraction of reference lesions that were detected, regardless of their size.

$$\mathrm{L\text{-}TPR} = \frac{TP_{\mathrm{les}}}{TP_{\mathrm{les}} + FN_{\mathrm{les}}}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · lesion_recall
Hernandez Petzsche et al. 2022 (ISLES'22); Maier-Hein et al. 2024 (Metrics Reloaded)

Lesion-wise precision L-PPV

Fraction of predicted lesions that correspond to a real lesion (1 − false-discovery rate).

$$\mathrm{L\text{-}PPV} = \frac{TP_{\mathrm{les}}}{TP_{\mathrm{les}} + FP_{\mathrm{les}}}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · lesion_precision
Maier-Hein et al. 2024 (Metrics Reloaded)

Lesion-wise F1 score L-F1

Harmonic mean of lesion precision and recall: one number for 'found the lesions, and only them'.

$$\mathrm{L\text{-}F1} = \frac{2\,TP_{\mathrm{les}}}{2\,TP_{\mathrm{les}} + FP_{\mathrm{les}} + FN_{\mathrm{les}}}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · lesion_f1
Hernandez Petzsche et al. 2022, Sci Data 9:762 (ISLES'22)

Lesion-wise Dice (BraTS 2023) LW-DSC

Dice averaged over lesions, with missed and spurious lesions each scoring 0; small lesions count as much as large.

$$\mathrm{LW\text{-}DSC} = \frac{1}{N_G + FP_{\mathrm{les}}}\sum_{i=1}^{N_G} \mathrm{DSC}\Big(G_i,\ \textstyle\bigcup_{j: P_j\cap G_i\neq\emptyset} P_j\Big)$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · lesionwise_dice
Kazerooni et al. 2023, arXiv:2305.17033; BraTS-2023-Metrics code (github.com/rachitsaluja/BraTS-2023-Metrics)

Panoptic quality PQ

Detection quality × segmentation quality of matched lesions: F1 of IoU>0.5 matches times their mean IoU.

$$\mathrm{PQ} = \underbrace{\frac{\sum_{(p,g)\in TP}\mathrm{IoU}(p,g)}{|TP|}}_{SQ}\times \underbrace{\frac{|TP|}{|TP| + \tfrac12|FP| + \tfrac12|FN|}}_{RQ}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · panoptic_quality
Kirillov et al. 2019, CVPR (Panoptic Segmentation)

False-positive lesion count FP lesions

Number of predicted components that overlap no reference lesion.

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit – · false_positive_lesions
Maier-Hein et al. 2024 (Metrics Reloaded); Chakraborty & Berbaum 2004, Med Phys 31(8) (FROC)

Missed lesion count FN lesions

Number of reference lesions that were not detected.

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit – · false_negative_lesions
Maier-Hein et al. 2024 (Metrics Reloaded)

Absolute lesion count difference |ΔN|

How many more or fewer lesions were predicted than exist (ISLES'22 secondary metric).

$$|\Delta N| = |N_P - N_G|$$

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit – · lesion_count_difference
Hernandez Petzsche et al. 2022, Sci Data 9:762 (ISLES'22)

Centreline Dice clDice

Dice computed on skeletons: rewards connected, complete tubular structures (vessels, airways, ducts).

$$\mathrm{clDice} = 2\,\frac{T_{\mathrm{prec}}\,T_{\mathrm{sens}}}{T_{\mathrm{prec}}+T_{\mathrm{sens}}},\quad T_{\mathrm{prec}} = \frac{|S_P\cap G|}{|S_P|},\; T_{\mathrm{sens}} = \frac{|S_G\cap P|}{|S_G|}$$

Range [0.000, 1.000] · higher is better · unit – · cldice
Shit et al. 2021, CVPR (clDice)

Betti-0 error (components) β₀ err

Difference in the number of connected pieces: counts spurious islands and fragmentation.

$$\varepsilon_{\beta_0} = |\beta_0(P) - \beta_0(G)|$$

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit – · betti0_error
Hu et al. 2019, NeurIPS (TopoLoss); Yang et al. 2023, arXiv:2312.17670 (TopCoW)

Betti-1 error (tunnels/loops) β₁ err

Difference in the number of loops/handles: e.g. a vessel ring (circle of Willis) opened or falsely closed.

$$\varepsilon_{\beta_1} = |\beta_1(P) - \beta_1(G)|$$

Range [0.000, ∞] · lower is better · unit – · betti1_error
Hu et al. 2019, NeurIPS; Yang et al. 2023 (TopCoW)

SegEvalKit · per-case results in per_case.csv; full configuration in meta.json.
